consensus_summary: Primary consensus meaning of the net is the gospel/kingdom of God as instrument for gathering people of every kind into the church via evangelism and apostolic mission (fishers of men + dragnet parable); common secondary senses are snare/trap of the wicked and instrument of divine judgment.
book_summary: The gospel’s gathering of all kinds out of the sea of peoples.
consensus_core_identification: net as gospel/kingdom instrument that gathers people of all kinds
book_core_identification: gospel’s gathering of all kinds out of the sea of peoples
rationale: Minimum cores are identical: both identify the net with the gospel’s/kingdom’s gathering of every kind of person (explicitly linked by the book and by consensus to the dragnet of Matt 13:47-48, and treated by consensus as the dominant positive Christian reading). Wording differences (gospel vs kingdom, sea of peoples) and the consensus’s additional secondary senses or fishers-of-men emphasis are immaterial detail that do not alter the shared central referent or its extension.
strongest_objection: Consensus frequently pairs the dragnet with the fishers-of-men call as co-primary; the book entry cites only the former, yet this is compatible rather than contradictory.
